Lee: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Recording + slides: https://redwood.example/ah/mar-2026-recording and https://redwood.example/ah/mar-2026-slides. TL;DR below.

Jordan: Appreciate the turnout. Quick note: Dedicated GA shifted to Aug 15 so engineering has time for final SLO work.

Priya: Clarify roadmap priorities: 1) Dedicated GA (latency + autoscale), 2) Optimize beta (cost profiler + quant suggestions), 3) Private on-prem pilot expansion. Owners: Marco (runtime), Sam (infra), Anika (customer ops). I'll own product follow-ups.

Marco: Will spin up RFC and draft milestone checklist. Initial items: kernel tuning, perf bench suite, canary plan. I'll post PR by Wed.

Sam: I'll create infra tickets for capacity and SLO monitoring. Runbook stub: https://runbooks.redwood.example/dedicated-ga (will expand).

Emily: Quick Q from a customer: will 8-bit / int8 quantization be supported at GA on Dedicated? Marco?

Marco: Yes — int8 via qconfig-v2 is in the runtime, behind a feature flag for now. Compatibility matrix + caveats will be added to docs: https://docs.redwood.example/quantization.

Anika: I'll draft customer comms + FAQ by Fri EOD. Need any blocking legal/security review?

Jordan: Security already cleared the pilot code path, just need final KMS/key rotation notes.

Priya: Action items summary (owners + target):
- Marco: RFC + milestone PR by Wed (2200570000)
- Sam: infra tickets + runbook update by Thu (2200650000)
- Anika: customer comms draft by Fri (2200720000)
- Emily: compile top-5 customer asks by Tue (2200600000)
Please attach links and set due dates in Asana.

Lee: Also please add a short "what could break" list for each item. Use #release-war-room for release coordination. I'll follow up with a 30-min sync invite tomorrow.

Emily: Small ask — can we get a brief note for the community channel once GA date is firm? :thumbsup: 

Anika: Yep, I'll schedule a post and include docs + migration guide.

deploy-bot: Deployment window placeholder: canary start 2022-08-01T10:00Z -> rolling to GA 2022-08-15T18:00Z (update once dates confirmed).

Marco: One more: need volunteers for perf testing next week. Pinged eng-runtime list.

Sam: I'll coordinate the load generator and share the scripts:
```
./scripts/loadtest --profile=dedicated-ga --concurrency=200
```
Lee: Thanks — I'll mark these as action items and will check off during tomorrow's sync. If anything urgent ping me directly.

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Priya: noted.

Marco: adding tickets now, will post links here when done.

Emily: posting customer asks doc shortly.

Anika: comms draft in #marketing-review when ready.

Lee: closing thread for now; will reopen if any blockers surface before the sync.
